Handling guidelines

Before updating a shipment, compare the destination against the customer's confirmed address and review the latest carrier event. A recent delivery attempt may explain why an otherwise valid address was flagged for manual review.

When a payment is pending, check the settlement date and the transaction reference shown in the payment system. Avoid changing order status until the payment event and the customer record agree.
